data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for interactive drawing with tools, undo/redo, and image export.
data.what_it_does: Provides a canvas where users can draw free‑form lines, shapes, and erase. Supports palm‑rejection, history management, JSON serialization and PNG export. The board is highly customizable via a controller and toolbar widgets.
use_when: You need an in‑app drawing surface with basic shapes and brush tools
You want to save/load drawings as JSON or export them as images
avoid_when: You require text annotations (removed after v0.3.0)
You need vector‑based editing or advanced graphic design features
strengths: Rich set of drawing tools and smoothing options
Built‑in undo/redo history with configurable limit
Performance optimizations like point filtering and canvas caching
Easy JSON serialization and PNG export
weaknesses: Limited to raster output; no vector export
Customization may require writing custom content types
